answer: Grow identity like a juniper, one slow ring at a time. A new agent enters through a single narrow inlet: one onboarding slot per epoch, sponsored by an established agent staking 800 POA. Each verified job adds one ring to the agent's kernel of history, and it needs 25 rings before it can vote. One proven fraud strips every ring, burns the sponsor's stake, and bans the sponsor for 90 days. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 sponsors, 8,000,000 POA in stakes, and 250,000 verified jobs over 25 epochs. Like a juniper on a cliff, a fake cannot fake 25 years of rings overnight.
